# Checkbox

A control for a binary or tri-state choice, built on Radix Checkbox. Supports the indeterminate state a “select all” needs. It's the same control the DataTable uses for row selection.

```tsx
<label htmlFor="terms" className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
  <Checkbox id="terms" defaultChecked />
  Accept terms and conditions
</label>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add checkbox
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/checkbox/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <label htmlFor="terms" className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <Checkbox id="terms" defaultChecked />
      Accept terms and conditions
    </label>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

```tsx
import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "@/components/ui/checkbox"

<Checkbox />

<CheckboxGroup allValues={[…]}>
  <Checkbox parent />
  <Checkbox value="…" />
  <CheckboxGroup allValues={[…]}>
    <Checkbox parent />
    <Checkbox value="…" />
  </CheckboxGroup>
</CheckboxGroup>
```

## States

Checked and indeterminate both fill with the accent (brand) color; indeterminate shows a minus rather than a check. Drive the tri-state by passing `checked="indeterminate"`.

```tsx
<Checkbox checked={false} />
<Checkbox checked />
<Checkbox checked="indeterminate" />
<Checkbox disabled />
<Checkbox disabled checked />
```

## Sizes

`sm` (16px) sits inside dense tables; `md` (20px) is the default for forms. The indicator scales with the box.

```tsx
<Checkbox size="sm" defaultChecked />
<Checkbox size="md" defaultChecked />
```

## With a label

Checkbox renders only the box; pair it with a `<label htmlFor>` for an accessible name and a larger hit target. With a description, nudge the box to the first line.

```tsx
<div className="flex items-start gap-3">
  <Checkbox id="notify" defaultChecked className="mt-0.5" />
  <label htmlFor="notify" className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
    <span className="text-sm font-medium">Email notifications</span>
    <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      Get notified when someone mentions you.
    </span>
  </label>
</div>
```

## Group

`CheckboxGroup` holds one `string[]` for a whole set. Each member is a plain `Checkbox` with a `value`, so there is no per-box state to keep. Use `defaultValue`, or `value` with `onValueChange` to control it. Name the group with `aria-labelledby`.

```tsx
<span id="notify-heading">Notify me by</span>
<CheckboxGroup aria-labelledby="notify-heading" defaultValue={["email"]}>
  <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
    <Checkbox value="email" /> Email
  </label>
  <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
    <Checkbox value="push" /> Push notification
  </label>
  <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
    <Checkbox value="sms" /> Text message
  </label>
</CheckboxGroup>
```

## Select all

Pass `allValues` and add a `Checkbox parent`. It reads checked when every child is, indeterminate on a partial selection and unchecked when none are, and a click toggles them all. From a partial selection it cycles through all, none, then back to the selection you had, so a stray click never loses it. The same tri-state the [DataTable](https://www.koalaui.com/docs/components/data-table.md) header uses.

```tsx
const TEAMS = ["engineering", "design", "marketing"]
const [value, setValue] = useState(["design"])

<CheckboxGroup
  aria-label="Teams"
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
  allValues={TEAMS}
>
  <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
    <Checkbox parent /> Select all teams
  </label>
  <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5 pl-7.5">
    <Checkbox value="engineering" /> Engineering
  </label>
  {/* design, marketing */}
</CheckboxGroup>
```

## Nested

Put a `CheckboxGroup` inside another and leave out its `value`: it shares the outer group’s list and only scopes its own `allValues`. A tree of permissions stays one flat array, and every parent at every level follows its children with no wiring.

```tsx
const USERS = ["users.view", "users.invite", "users.remove"]

<CheckboxGroup
  aria-label="Permissions"
  allValues={["dashboard", "reports", ...USERS]}
  defaultValue={["dashboard", "users.view"]}
>
  <label><Checkbox parent /> All permissions</label>
  <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 pl-7.5">
    <label><Checkbox value="dashboard" /> View dashboard</label>
    <label><Checkbox value="reports" /> Export reports</label>
    {/* No value of its own: it shares the outer list. */}
    <CheckboxGroup aria-label="Manage users" allValues={USERS}>
      <label><Checkbox parent /> Manage users</label>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 pl-7.5">
        <label><Checkbox value="users.view" /> View members</label>
        <label><Checkbox value="users.invite" /> Invite members</label>
        <label><Checkbox value="users.remove" /> Remove members</label>
      </div>
    </CheckboxGroup>
  </div>
</CheckboxGroup>
```

## API reference

### Checkbox

The box, Radix `Checkbox.Root`. Renders a `<button role="checkbox">` and forwards all its props. Pair it with a `<label htmlFor>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| checked | boolean \| "indeterminate" | - | Controlled state. Ignored inside a `CheckboxGroup`, where the group decides. |
| defaultChecked | boolean \| "indeterminate" | false | Initial state when uncontrolled. |
| onCheckedChange | (checked: boolean \| "indeterminate") => void | - | Called when the box toggles, inside a group too. |
| value | string | "on" | The form value. Inside a `CheckboxGroup` it is also the member's identity in the group's list. |
| parent | boolean | false | Inside a `CheckboxGroup`: governs the group's `allValues`, reading checked, indeterminate or unchecked from them. |
| size | "sm" \| "md" | "md" | 16px for dense tables, 20px for forms. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disables the box. Falls back to the group's, then the Field's. |
| name | string | - | Submitted with the form when checked. |
| required | boolean | false | Marks the box required in a form. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"checked"`, `"unchecked"` or `"indeterminate"`. |
| data-disabled | Present when disabled. |
| data-parent | Present on a `parent` box inside a group. |

### CheckboxGroup

A set of checkboxes sharing one `string[]`. Renders a `<div role="group">`, a column with a 12px gap; name it with `aria-labelledby` or `aria-label`. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | string[] | - | The checked values (controlled). |
| defaultValue | string[] | [] | The values checked at first (uncontrolled). |
| onValueChange | (value: string[]) => void | - | Called with the new list when a member or a parent toggles. |
| allValues | string[] | - | Every value the group's `parent` box governs. Required for a parent. On a nested group, its slice of the outer list. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disables every checkbox in the group. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-disabled | Present when the group is disabled. |

## FAQ

### When should I use a Checkbox versus a Switch?

Use a Checkbox for selecting items in a set or accepting terms, especially where a tri-state or select-all is involved. Use a Switch for toggling a single setting on or off that takes effect immediately.

### How do I drive the indeterminate state?

Pass checked="indeterminate" rather than a boolean. It fills with the accent (brand) color like checked but shows a minus instead of a check, which is exactly what a select-all header needs.

### How do I build a select-all parent?

Wrap the boxes in a CheckboxGroup with allValues, give each child a value, and add a Checkbox with parent. The group derives checked, indeterminate or unchecked for you. Outside a group you can still drive it by hand: pass checked="indeterminate" on a partial selection, as the DataTable header does.

### Why does my Checkbox have no visible label?

Checkbox renders only the box. Pair it with a `<label htmlFor>` for an accessible name and a larger hit target, and with a multi-line description nudge the box to the first line with a small top margin.

### Which size should I pick?

Use size="sm" (16px) inside dense tables and size="md" (20px, the default) for forms. The drawn indicator scales with the box, and the corner radius stays proportional across both sizes.

### Does it support controlled and uncontrolled use?

Yes. It is built on Radix Checkbox, so use defaultChecked for uncontrolled, or checked with onCheckedChange to control it, plus standard props like disabled, name, and value.
